design: Classification-criteria development and validation study (5-stage: consensus items, DCVAS prospective observational cohort, data-driven item reduction, expert-panel reference diagnosis, LASSO logistic regression derivation with split-sample validation)
population: Adults (>=18 y) with vasculitis or vasculitis mimics in DCVAS (6991 participants, 136 sites, 32 countries, Jan 2011-Dec 2017); MPA reference-diagnosis cases n=291 vs comparators n=822 (GPA 300, EGPA 226, PAN 51, non-ANCA small-vessel vasculitis 51, Behcet 50, IgA vasculitis 50, cryoglobulinaemic 34, AAV unsubtyped 25, PCNSV 19, anti-GBM 16)
reference_standard: Expert panel review (55 experts, >=moderate certainty) of case vignettes; 291 MPA reference diagnoses (269 retained physician diagnosis + 22 reclassified)
overlap_note: Simultaneous duplicate publication of SUPPIAH2022_AR (same study, same patients). C2 (404 physician-diagnosed MPA) contains 269 of the 291 patients of C1.
notes: Only Table 1 (MPA n=291 vs comparators n=822, comparator column not extracted) and a few text percentages describe MPA features. Not a prevalence study: patients are selected as MPA by expert review and enriched for classifiable cases; comparators are a non-random mix. Sensitivity/specificity/AUC of the criteria and item weights are properties of the criteria set, not features of MPA patients; not extracted as observations. Supplementary appendices (candidate items, regression, per-item prevalences) are referred to but not available.
